changelog: Phone link (Pro): phones on the same Wi-Fi now connect without a firewall prompt, including on networks Windows marks as Public.
If a phone still can't connect, the Drop Shelf now links straight to the Windows Firewall settings.
Play/pause, next, previous and seeking now control the app shown in the notch, such as Spotify, even when a browser tab also has media.
The notch no longer stays stuck at an odd size after the PC wakes from sleep, a full-screen app closes, or Show desktop.
